title: Dashboard
alt_text: User Reminder dashboard with counters, a 30-day send chart and system health
caption: The dashboard counts pending activations, never-logged-in and inactive users, charts the last 30 days of reminders and checks your setup.

title: Registration reminders
alt_text: List of users who registered but never activated their account
caption: Users who never activated their account, with the last reminder date and how many reminders they got.

title: Inactive users
alt_text: List of users who have not logged in for 30 days or more
caption: Members who have not logged in for a while, sorted by last login, with days inactive and reminders sent.

title: Reminder email
alt_text: Inactivity reminder email with site header, message and unsubscribe link
caption: A reminder email in the HTML container: your header, the message, a link back and a one-click unsubscribe link.

title: Email templates
alt_text: Joomla Mail Templates list showing the three User Reminder emails
caption: The three reminder emails are Joomla mail templates, so you can edit them per language.

title: Edit an email
alt_text: Editing the inactivity reminder template with subject, body and insert tags
caption: Edit the subject and text, and insert tags such as the user's name, site link and opt-out link.

title: Opt-out users
alt_text: List of users who unsubscribed from reminders
caption: Users who unsubscribed never get reminders. Add or remove people by hand.

title: Opt-out groups
alt_text: User group list with the Manager group ticked as opted out
caption: Tick user groups, such as staff, whose members never get reminders.

title: Action log
alt_text: Action log with reminders sent and opt-outs per user and date
caption: Every reminder sent, every unsubscribe and resubscribe, with user and date.

title: Reminder options
alt_text: Options tab with settings per reminder type
caption: Turn each reminder type on or off, and choose whether users are deleted after the last reminder.

title: Email design
alt_text: Email container options with header title, footer text and colours
caption: Set the email header, footer text and colours, or show your logo.

title: Scheduled task
alt_text: Joomla Scheduled Tasks list with the User Reminder emails task
caption: Reminders go out through Joomla's Task Scheduler, with last and next run times.

title: Unsubscribe page
alt_text: Front-end unsubscribe page asking the user to confirm
caption: The unsubscribe link opens a confirmation page on your site, so a click by a mail scanner does not opt the user out.
